description.value: Design for a composition, possibly for an invitation or poster advertising the Reimann School. At center, the word “art” spelled out with an artist’s pallet in white outline, a large capital letter R in white outline, and a solid black letter T, arranged at a diagonal angle from lower left to upper right. Above and to the left, an abstracted yellow flower. The background is formed by blue, brown, pink and black shapes, and a frame of undulating black and white lines.

Study is for a poster advertising the Bicycle and Motorcycle Show at Olympia Figure’s head is depicted in bottom right corner of the page, with only a crescent-moon shaped smile drawn on the face. The figure’s right arm extends up to the top left corner of the page, and is shown with palm open, and a jacket and shirt sleeve covering the arm. Faint graphite lines are seen across the page.

description.value: Study for a motif, likely for a poster or advertisement. In the foreground at left, a tall brown telephone tower, with black wires extending at an angle downwards at to the right, connecting to a gray sphere at the top of a second tower in black. On top of the sphere, an American flag. To the left of the tower, an abstract depiction of the Statue of Liberty in white and gray, with star spangled clouds and red and white stripes surrounding the statue’s head. In the foreground (between the brown tower and the Statue of Liberty) a large black rectangle leaning to the left, resembling a large bollard on a dock. The background is shaded in yellow and blue.

legal.credit: Gift of Mrs. E. McKnight Kauffer

On the figure’s chest, a line of medals.
